title: Clay Shaw phones Fred Crisman during the Garrison investigation
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Clay Shaw phones Fred Crisman during the Garrison investigation, about 1967-1969 at New Orleans, Louisiana, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Klay Shaw and Fred Chrisman seem to have known each other well enough that Klay Shaw phoned him at the time that all of this was going on with the Jim Garrison and the Kennedy assassination.

plain: A researcher and author named Peter Levenda, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that a New Orleans man named Clay Shaw and another man named Fred Crisman seem to have known each other well. He says Shaw phoned Crisman in the late 1960s, while Jim Garrison, a New Orleans prosecutor, was investigating the Kennedy assassination. He raises it as a hint of hidden connections between people caught up in that case.
